UPDATE message_recovery r SET r.state='RESOLVED',r.resolved_at=#{now},r.next_attempt_at=NULL, r.lock_version=r.lock_version+1,r.updated_at=#{now}, r.updated_by_type='SERVICE',r.updated_by_id=NULL WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.recovery_id=#{recoveryId} AND r.direction='INBOX' AND r.state IN ('OPEN','REPLAYING') AND r.lock_version=#{expectedVersion} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inbox_message i WHERE i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.inbox_id=r.source_record_id AND i.direction='INBOX' AND i.status IN ('PROCESSED','REJECTED') )
